name: product_error_read_v14clean

Otherwise as product_error_read_v14.

estimate.basis: the carried version's read took 102 s on 16 Nov 2026 (product_error_read: 47 stored molecules, three checkpoints loaded per molecule); this one reads the same 47 (a8 and b)
